## Required for every submission
- [ ] ZIP is in `packages/`, built from the tagged source with documented steps. sha256 in `catalog/entries.json` was computed from the final ZIP bytes (not supplied by the author)
- [ ] Version is new. Published versions are never overwritten
- [ ] Source repo has a LICENSE and README
- [ ] No obfuscated or minified code without source tree, tag and build instructions
- [ ] Every permission is justified below
- [ ] Reviewed all source, manifest contributions and panel HTML/scripts

## Risk tier (see docs/REVIEW.md)
- [ ] Tier 0 (declarative, no permissions)  - [ ] Tier 1 (panels or low permissions)
- [ ] Tier 2 (worker code or project.write): two reviewers
- [ ] Tier 3 (network, ai.query, git.commit): two reviewers, reproducible build, staged rollout
